bullets.title: PLTR: Goldman upgrades to Buy ($230 PT) on sovereign AI TAM step-function change
bullets.body: GS raises PLTR from Neutral to Buy, lifting PT to $230 from $204 (~18% upside), citing the FDE model compounding via AI automation feedback loops and expanding U.S. government/sovereign AI deployment driving a TAM step-function change into 2027. PLTR has lagged peers (SNOW/NET/DDOG up 50-100% YTD vs PLTR +9%) and trades at discount on EV/FCF, supporting the constructive view. Revenue estimates rise meaningfully from 2027 onward.

bullets.title: TYL: Goldman downgrades to Neutral, cuts PT to $345 from $395
bullets.body: GS downgrades TYL from Buy to Neutral, cutting PT to $345 from $395, citing the cloud-transition thesis as largely played out with limited visibility into the next AI-driven catalyst. Downside risk remains around cloud-conversion timing and execution.

bullets.title: MSFT: Morgan Stanley reiterates OW $600 PT on Enterprise AI Flywheel; JPM also favors into Q3
bullets.body: MS reiterates OW on MSFT with $600 PT (13.4% upside), arguing its four-layer AI stack (Azure+Maia/Cobalt, Fabric, Foundry, M365 Copilot) lets it monetize the same workflow at multiple points, reducing model-winner risk; 47% of CIOs prefer MSFT for custom AI apps, Fabric at $2B run-rate growing ~60% YoY. JPM separately expects ~10M+ Copilot seat adds in Q3 with building monetization and modest M365 Commercial Cloud upside. FY27e EPS $19.66 inflects to +22.4% growth in FY28e.

bullets.title: HUBS: JPMorgan downgrades to Neutral on delayed AI monetization
bullets.body: JPM downgrades HUBS to Neutral, citing AI monetization delayed vs. expectations and medium-term revenue growth at risk. The action is part of JPM's broader software preview favoring MSFT, NOW, NET, and SNOW into Q3 earnings.

bullets.title: NOW/NET/SNOW: JPM expects Q3 beats; cRPO, Workers, migration pace key catalysts
bullets.body: JPM previews Q3: NOW expected to beat cRPO by ~200bps with robust ~20% growth and likely raise AI ACV target beyond $1.5B; SNOW expected to deliver upside on accelerated migration with F4Q27 acceleration; NET expected to see revenue accelerate to high-30% YoY range driven by Workers and AI demand. Infrastructure software upside via positive estimate revisions; application software via multiple re-rating.

bullets.title: NFLX: Morgan Stanley reiterates OW, cuts PT to $80 on FX; ad revenue to triple to $4.8B by 2027
bullets.body: MS maintains OW on NFLX but trims PT to $80 from $83 (18x FY28 EPS) due to FX headwinds. Ad revenue forecast to triple from ~$1.6B (2025) to $4.8B (2027) and reach $6.6B by 2028; India shows +25-30% YoY viewing growth; UCAN revenue growing +11% YoY in Q3. Stock trades at ~15x FY28 EPS with 150-200bps margin expansion potential. Hedgeye flags NFLX on bearish trend signal.

bullets.title: AVGO: Arranging $30-50B+ financing for OpenAI/Anthropic custom chip buildout
bullets.body: Multiple sources confirm Broadcom is arranging $30-50B+ in debt financing to help OpenAI purchase its custom Jalapeno chips, on top of an already-launched $60B deal for Anthropic. Oracle and SpaceX are pursuing similar AI chip financing arrangements. This represents a structural shift as frontier labs lack balance sheet capacity to fund AI infrastructure.

bullets.title: ANET: Citi raises to #1 networking pick with higher PT on AI capex surge; 2027 capex growth revised to 40%+ YoY
bullets.body: Citi raises ANET estimates and PT, making it the top networking pick, as Big Five hyperscale capex growth increased to +93% YoY for 2026 (up 10% from June expectations) and 2027 projections revised to >40% YoY from >30%. ANET's footprint is diversifying into Amazon and Google, partially offset by Oracle competition. LITE remains #2 pick on CPO/OCS opportunity.

bullets.title: SPOT: Piper Sandler initiates Neutral ($540 PT); renews Joe Rogan deal at ~$250M
bullets.body: Piper Sandler initiated SPOT at Neutral with $540 PT (~5% upside from $512.92, below FactSet consensus of $591). Separately, Spotify confirmed a new multi-year Joe Rogan licensing agreement estimated at $250M on similar prior terms, securing its highest-profile content anchor.

bullets.title: RCL: Jefferies upgrades to Buy, PT $330 on Sandals JV and net yield reacceleration
bullets.body: Jefferies upgrades RCL from Hold to Buy, raising PT to $330 from $305, on reaccelerating FY27 net yield growth (+3.3% vs +2.9% prior) and Sandals JV upside estimated at ~$159M equity income (~$0.59 in Adj. EPS) with no synergy assumptions yet reflected. RCL trades at <13.0x NTM EV/EBITDA near the lower end of its historical range.

bullets.title: GNRC: Piper Sandler initiates OW at $303 (39% upside) on $4B data center backlog; KeyBanc upgrades
bullets.body: Piper Sandler initiates GNRC at Overweight with $303 PT (39% upside), citing a ~$4B data center backup power backlog built in under a year and a $16-21B/yr addressable market through 2032; GNRC trades at 9.3x 2028E EV/EBITDA, ~6 turns below C&I peers. KeyBanc separately upgraded GNRC to Overweight; stock +3.0% in premarket.

bullets.title: GOOGL: Cloud Gemini agent launch; earnings setup shows TPU revenue uncertainty ($5-7B range)
bullets.body: Google Cloud launched a unified Gemini agent with multi-agent orchestration, autonomous task execution, and persistent context across web, iOS, Android, Windows, Mac, integrating with Workspace, M365, and Slack. Heading into earnings, Jefferies notes Cloud revenue expectations range 110-115% with wide uncertainty around TPU sales ($5-7B range); Search expected to decelerate ~13.5% YoY. Piper flags META and GOOGL as best internet setups on agentic narrative.

bullets.title: AAPL: Citi maintains Buy ahead of Nov 2 earnings; agentic AI disintermediation risk flagged
bullets.body: Citi maintains AAPL Buy ahead of Sep-Q results on 11/2; focus is on Services growth diversification beyond App Store (2% YoY growth vs 9.5% total Services guidance). iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max delivery tracker shows slightly less pronounced upgrade cycle vs last year; CY26/27 units kept at 1.4%/6.7% growth. Agentic AI poses incremental disintermediation risk to Services but Agentic Siri could expand TAM via premium access and commerce fees. Dec-Q modeled below consensus on different launch cadence.

bullets.title: U (Unity): Multiple upgrades; GOOGL AI gaming partnership seen as bullish for Create/Vector
bullets.body: Raymond James upgraded U (+2.0% premarket); MS reiterates OW with $50 PT noting every 1M new users is ~1% EBITDA upside for FY28; JPM/OpCo note U launched an AI game-creation platform (Playground, Oct 7) with Google partnership via Unity Spark integration. Jefferies expects U to be the biggest mobile gaming market share gainer in 2027. APP faces a 7% EBITDA headwind in 2027 as the current share leader.

bullets.title: DELL/HPE/GLW/STX/WDC: Citi most bullish on connectivity and HDD into Q3 on durable AI demand
bullets.body: Citi's hardware/networking coverage is up +125% YTD vs S&P +14%, led by storage, OEMs, and connectivity. Most bullish on connectivity (APH, GLW) on multi-end-market thesis with Defense as an emerging secular driver; prefers HDD (STX, WDC) over NAND on lower competitive intensity and margin expansion. Toshiba HDD expansion news seen as attractive entry for STX/WDC. DELL and HPE favored OEMs on supply chain moat.

bullets.title: AMD/TXN: Citi top semi picks; SOX +24% from summer lows but estimate revisions slowing
bullets.body: Citi notes SOX rebounded 24% from summer correction; data center demand now ~40% of semis TAM. Estimate revision momentum slowed in Q2 and expected to moderate further in Q3. Top buy-rated picks are AMD and TXN; NXPI downgraded to Neutral (PT $260 from $370) on limited data center exposure, OLED to Sell (PT $71 from $85) on smartphone weakness, NVMI to Neutral (PT $415 from $550). Wolfe separately projects WFE at $200B CY27 and $260B CY28 with AMAT as top SCE pick.

bullets.title: CZR/PENN/BYD: Ohio September Racino GGR beats JPM estimates across the board
bullets.body: Ohio September Racino GGR +7% YoY; Q3 +6% YoY. CZR's Scioto Downs posted +6.8% September / +7% Q3 vs JPM's +4% estimate. PENN racinos +3.1% September / +3% Q3 vs JPM's flat estimate. BYD's Belterra Park -1.5% September / +1% Q3 vs JPM's +2% estimate — the only slight miss.

bullets.title: NBIS: Rosenblatt initiates Buy with $304 PT (28% upside)
bullets.body: Rosenblatt Securities initiated Nebius Group (NBIS) at Buy with a $304 PT, representing 28% upside from $237.15. FactSet consensus target is $289 with a range of $84-$410.

bullets.title: META: Piper flags as best internet setup on agentic narrative; +18% since Muse launch
bullets.body: Piper Sandler identifies META as one of the two best internet setups heading into Q3 (alongside GOOGL), citing the powerful agentic narrative and +18% stock gain since Muse launch. Q3 ad spend grew 8.6% YoY, ~90bps above expectations, with strength in AI, GLP-1s, sports, travel, tech, and movies offsetting weakness in autos, CPG, and financials.

bullets.title: SHOP/AMZN/GOOGL: AI-assisted shopping adoption to be measured via Roth QSG survey
bullets.body: Roth QSG launching a 500-750 person survey to quantify AI-driven product discovery, purchase completion, and channel shift away from traditional search across Amazon, Google, Meta, and Shopify platforms. Focus includes agentic checkout capabilities and trust barriers, with retail media traffic implications for all four names.
